Public network data. Ethereum information is retrieved from Blockscout’s public indexer and may be delayed or temporarily unavailable. Satstreet does not independently verify this data.

Network overview

XRP Ledger

Most recent

Latest ledgers

Public network data. XRP Ledger information is retrieved from public XRP Ledger servers, with token names and icons from XRPL Meta, and may be delayed or temporarily unavailable. Satstreet does not independently verify this data.

USD values use a reference rate and are indicative only. The XRP Ledger closes a new ledger every three to five seconds; only validated ledgers are final.
